summary.headline: Julian on Pivots and Planetary Sect
summary.text: Astrological descriptions of the zodiac signs’ landscapes, assignments of the four pivots to fugitives, masters, stolen goods, and persuaders, and the Moon’s role in locating flight. A new fragment of Julian of Laodicea discusses malefic and benefic stars, their houses, exaltations, bounds, triangles, depressions, and sect.
